$comment: E1 D3 long-take split hard constraints. All nine enter the executor contract template. evidence_status: prior.

rules.text: Each generated segment carries exactly one intent peak.
The next segment's generation condition is the previous segment's real tail frame, not the planned tail.
Camera movement type must not change across segments of one take.
Subject / wardrobe / light / lens locks are restated on every segment.
Exiting frame and re-entering is a new shot. Cross-segment memory of the subject is not a contract.
Stylized-medium segments are at most 4–5 seconds.
Seam acceptance uses one or more of: occluder cut-out, motion-vector continuity, exposure delta ≤ threshold, sound-leads-picture.
seed is not a continuity key. Same seed + same params yields similar results, not bitwise identity.
